description: This file defines a callback queue with thread pool management, including enqueueing, shutdown, and error handling for callbacks.

classes.name: CallbackQueue
classes.description: A thread pool for processing callback functions with enqueue, shutdown, and execution management.

methods.name: NewCallbackQueue
methods.description: Creates and starts a new callback queue with specified parameters.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Stops accepting new callbacks and waits for existing threads to exit or timeout.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a callback function to the queue for processing.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Worker thread function that processes callbacks from the queue.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a callback function with panic recovery and error logging.
